condensed_brd: Objective: This BRD defines an enhancement to the existing Dynamics 365 CRM Lead qualification experience. Scope: Out-of-the-box Lead table and the existing Lead Main; Existing Lead columns: Topic, First Name, Last Name; Two custom columns only: Qualification Score (Whole Number); Client-side JavaScript for scoring, warnings, contact-channel validation, and; A custom main-form command bar button labeled Validate; A server-side Dataverse plug-in that blocks qualification when; Solution packaging, deployment, and testing of the form. Integrations: none. Data: no migration. Non-functional needs: Performance. Client calculation shall be immediate for normal form interaction and the plug-in shall retrieve/process Compatibility. The enhancement shall be tested in the organization’s supported browsers, Dynamics 365 app, and. Rollout: .

risks.mitigation: Check platform limits and the vendor release calendar during design and keep a solution backup before each release.

Integrations: none. Data: no migration. Non-functional needs: Performance. Common app screens should load within 3 seconds under normal tenant/network conditions for up Availability.
